test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the functions of a lube oil pump?

options.text: Maintains consistent oil circulation throughout the engine.
Provides direction for the oil’s passage through the galleries and to various areas.
Oil is transferred to the engine’s key components under high pressure,.
The movement of engine lubricant around the engine is made difficult

solution:
The correct answer is __The movement of engine lubricant around the engine is made difficult.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lube oil pumps__ are essential for maintaining proper lubrication in engines.
 
• The pump ensures consistent oil circulation throughout the engine to avoid wear and tear.
 
• It provides the necessary pressure to transfer oil to critical engine components.
 
• The statement that the pump makes the movement of engine lubricant difficult is incorrect as its purpose is to facilitate smooth movement.
 
• The oil passages are designed to direct oil efficiently to all required areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions of a Lube Oil Pump:**

 
 
• Provides lubrication to reduce friction and wear between engine components.
 
• Helps in cooling the engine by removing excess heat generated during operation.
 
 
 
• **Engine Lubrication System:**
 
 
• Consists of components like the oil pump, filter, and oil galleries for efficient operation.
 
• Ensures smooth performance and extends engine life.
